top_signals.title: Global Stocks Hold Near Record High, Yen Weakens: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Global stocks held near record highs and futures pointed to further gains after a tech-led Wall Street rally followed a month of high volatility. The yen gave back some of its recent advance that was triggered by US and Japanese intervention.

top_signals.title: Venezuela’s Oil Exports Fall Even as U.S. Shipments Hit Seven-Year High
top_signals.summary: Venezuela exported 1.16 million barrels of crude oil daily last month, a slight decline from June’s 1.2 million barrels daily, on lower withdrawals from storage, Reuters has reported, noting that exports to the United States during that month increased. July exports to Venezuela’s biggest oil destination averaged 786,000 barrels daily, which was the highest since early 2019, Reuters noted in its report.
